task_definition.task_description: Please check whether flight CA1234 is on time, and if it is, book it for Alice Chen in economy class. Then get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate, prepare a medium-priority in-app balance report payload for user_01’s checking account, convert and format the balance details, and create a document titled “Balance Report” with that information.
